articles.summary: Founding Board member provided more than 25 years of leadership, guidance and counsel to the Bank. Mr. Patent served on the Board from the Bank's inception in 1999 until his passing. His extensive experience in real estate investment, finance and banking contributed to the Bank's development and growth. He also served in key Board leadership roles, including Chairman of the Bank's Loan Committee. Robert C. Patent “Bob was much more than a fellow Director. He was there from the beginning, helping us build Metropolitan Commercial Bank into the institution it is today,” said Mark R. DeFazio, Founder, President and CEO of Metropolitan Commercial Bank. “His judgment, experience and unwavering commitment to the Bank were invaluable. But what I will remember most is Bob himself—his integrity, his loyalty, his sense of humor and the friendship we shared over so many years. articles.title: Metropolitan Commercial Bank Mourns the Passing of Robert C. Patent, Founding Director
